pattern: Toolbar plus Tabs (Design, Preview, JSON); the canvas is a Sortable List (keyboard grab, move, drop with announcements); the palette and properties are labelled regions of native buttons and AbsoluteUI form controls.

keyboard.action: Add the field type after the selected field and select it.
Select the field and move focus to its properties.

keyboard.key: Space / Enter, arrows, Space / Enter, Escape
keyboard.action: Grab, move, drop, or cancel (Sortable List).
Switch between Design, Preview, and JSON.

focus: Removing a field focuses the next field's select button (or the first palette button); undo and redo keep focus where it is.
notes: Every pointer drag (palette to canvas, canvas reordering) has a keyboard equivalent (WCAG 2.5.7).
Additions, removals, moves, undo, and redo are announced through the polite live region; rejected edits are shown in an assertive Inline Message.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
